description: Agent runtime composition root for Agentic OS
pre_install: Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.530.0/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne 'cec65a2a9ba072a672ed60ad9f646ce22700f67201799727eb21b3fb906f73dc') { throw 'aoscompose checksum mismatch' }

Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.530.0/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne 'db46e1b1c6d8ad702448c0f27b009d3a167589424c5accd89d04942720e60129') { throw 'aosguard checksum mismatch' }
